title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the
            '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag. When true, the owner is allowed to be created even
            though another owner already has the same last name and address (for
            example, family members living together). Defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      description: A pet owner.

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:

              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-

## Summary

I implemented the `bulkSignupWarning` rule following the repository's existing convention for create-time, count-derived owner fields (exactly like `namesakeCount` and `customerCode`).

**Behavior:** When an owner is created, if more than 80 owners already carry the same adjusted business-day `registrationDate`, the new owner is created with `bulkSignupWarning: true`; otherwise `false`. This reuses the same per-day accumulation path as the existing daily-limit rule (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY = 100`), so the warning window is 81–100 owners for a given day.

**Changes:**
1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `bulkSignupWarning` boolean to the `Owner` schema (regenerates `OwnerDto` at build time).
2. **`Owner.java`** — added the `bulkSignupWarning` field with getter/setter and a `bulk_signup_warning` `@Column`.
3. **Schema SQL** (h2, hsqldb, mysql, postgres) — added the `bulk_signup_warning BOOLEAN` column to the `owners` table.
4. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — added the `BULK_SIGNUP_WARNING_THRESHOLD = 80` constant and an `assignBulkSignupWarning(owner)` step in `addOwner`, computed before persistence so it counts only pre-existing owners for the day. MapStruct auto-maps the field to the DTO by name, so it's present (never null) on both the create and GET responses.

The `AcceptanceTest` (fresh-create → `bulkSignupWarning` = false) passes, and the full suite reports `BUILD SUCCESS`.
